steps.title: Ask the borrower to explain each non-customer payer
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask the borrower to explain each non-customer payer
To: Borrower B0102, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0102)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 26 times, money sent to 'Northstar Wholesale LLC' came back from 'Northstar Wholesale LLC' within 35 days as a 'customer' payment of almost the same amount that settles no invoice ($119,345 in total) [ref S3-B0102-CIRCULAR_FLOW-8910d596]
  - $118,303 (7.6% of inflows) came from 'Northstar Wholesale LLC', who is not a known customer or obligor [ref S3-B0102-NON_OBLIGOR_PAYER-f219e9b2]

Please provide an explanation and supporting documents for each listed payment, including the relationship between you and each payer by 2026-09-17.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
